7998.d: The death altar is a runecrafting altar located in Death Rune Temple, which is used to craft death runes from pure essence with Runecrafting skill.

gt.heading: Access
gt.text:
As with most other rune temples, it can be accessed via the Abyss without a talisman.

Players can enter the ruins with any of the following talismans or replacements:
• A death talisman
• An omni-talisman
• A death tiara
• An omni-tiara
• A wicked hood imbued with any of the above
• A death talisman staff
• An omni-talisman staff
• A full set of ethereal outfit (while such a wicked hood is in the bank or the backpack, but not in armour case)

Players can reach the ruins in any of the following ways:
• Break a death altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
• The Tirannwn quiver 3 or 4 can teleport to the ruins 5 times a day.

Travelling from the Temple of Light

Entering the ruins by walking requires entering the Temple of Light and using the following directions.
# Go up the stairs at the main entrance.
# Go south and up the ladder.
# Go to the centre of the temple.
# Climb down the next stairs twice.
# Rotate the mirror to open the light door.
Note: When leaving, remember to rotate the mirror again for future visits.

gt.heading: Travelling from the Temple of Light
gt.text:

8078.d: Deep Sea Fishing is a Fishing activity that is accessed by talking to Goomah in the Fishing Guild.

gt.heading: Travelling merchant
gt.text:
Before the Travelling Merchant's Shop was disabled, the travelling merchant could previously occasionally appear at the centre of the hub hosting their shop, permanently offering an improved uncharted island map for 800,000 coins, as well as a selection of three other items that rotate daily. Once purchased, items will be marked as sold and cannot be purchased again on the same day. The merchant's stock changed at daily reset, 00:00 game time.

Purchasing any item from the merchant would complete the achievement, Up for Sail.

8080.d: The Deep Sea Fishing hub is a platform located off the coast of the Fishing Guild, north of East Ardougne.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
To get to the Deep Sea Fishing hub, choose the 'travel' option on Goomah south of the Fishing Guild bank. Reaching Goomah can be done through several ways:
• Use a skills necklace to teleport directly outside the Guild door.
• Use the Fishing Guild Teleport spell (found in the Lunar spellbook), or equivalently a Fishing guild teleport tablet.
• Teleport to the Ardougne lodestone, then head north.
• Teleport to the Seers' Village lodestone, then head south-west, following the coastline, past Hemenster.

Alternatively, players may reach the Deep Sea Fishing hub directly, though with higher requirements and costs:
• Attune a skill portal in the Max Guild to teleport to the rowboat inside the hub.
• Use a grace of the elves necklace to access the skill portal's teleport remotely. If the player does not have the requirements to enter the Max Guild, the necklace can be attuned to one location when first equipped.

8083.d: The Deep Wilderness Castle Ruins is a ruined structure deep in the Wilderness, a location constructed by the Dragonkin.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Directly teleporting there using Dragonkin Laboratory teleports purchased from Bryll Thoksdottir at Daemonheim (safest and fastest method).
• Use the teleport on the chest outside the Shadow Reef or the Temple of Aminishi (requires completion of Impressing the Locals).
• Use an Ancient Obelisk to teleport to the obelisk located near the Rogues' Castle in level 50 Wilderness, then run south east through the gate and continue east. Those with a Wilderness sword 3 or better may choose to be teleported to this obelisk directly. Otherwise, teleports are random and it may take several tries to reach this specific obelisk.

g.how: {{map}} on wiki page 'Deep Wilderness Castle Ruins'

8084.d: The Deep Wilderness Dungeon can be entered from an abandoned house in deep Wilderness by going down a set of stairs in level 51 Wilderness, south of the Pirates' Hideout.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Slayer cape or any of its variants to teleport to Mandrith, then run south.
• Wilderness sword 4 to the Wilderness Agility Course, then run east.
• Ghorrock Teleport to the Ice Plateau and run north through the gate and then east past the Wilderness Agility Course.
• Players may teleport to Deserted Keep east of the Mage Arena using the lever west of the Ardougne Castle or the one-way lever in the Edgeville Mausoleum. After cutting the web blocking the exit from Deserted Keep, run west past the Mage Arena.
